title: Safe Control of Feedback-Interconnected Systems via Singular Perturbations
summary: Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) have emerged as a powerful tool in the design of safety-critical controllers for nonlinear systems. In modern applications, complex systems often involve the feedback interconnection of subsystems evolving at different timescales, e.g., two parts from different physical domains (such as the electrical and mechanical parts of robotic systems) or a physical plant and an (optimization or control) algorithm.
